text:
sophie: HelioTech flagged that daily aggregates for multiple customers are off by whole-day shifts. Their edge devices batch events in local TZ but send timestamps as local_epoch_ms. Marketplace treats them as UTC -> some usage shifted to previous/next day. Need mitigation + recon plan.
alec: Ah right. They didn't ship timezone offset. We should detect improbable timezone patterns (e.g. many events clustered at 00:00 local) and attempt heuristic normalization.
mina: Billing shows net +/– deltas on daily invoices for 2026-02-14..2026-02-16. Customers see token-hours in wrong billing day which affects tiered pricing. We need a clean fix and a customer communication template.
sophie: Partner asks if we can auto-rebucket into their local day when confidence high, and produce a reconcile file for any change.
toby: Ops mitigation: mark suspect batches as `tz_ambiguous` and hold final ledger writes for 24h to allow backfill/backcompat. Also add metric `partner.helio.tz_ambiguous_count`.
alec: Implementation idea: enrichment step that looks for patterns: if >80% events in batch have epoch_ms % 86400000 within +/- 300000 of 00:00 and partner_timezone header missing -> assume local_timestamp; use partner.default_tz from partner_profile to convert. We'll add confidence score: 0.95 for exact pattern match, 0.7 for mixed clusters.
mina: Finance policy: auto-rebucket if confidence >= 0.9, provisional apply (no charge) if 0.6-0.9, hold if <0.6. Any rebucket that moves >10% of a customer's daily tokens -> notify customer ops and include off-cycle reconciliation.
sophie: partner webhook they'd like for notices (sample):
```
POST /partners/helio/webhooks/usage-rebucket
{
  "batch_id": "hb-20260215-01",
  "affected_customers": ["cust-123","cust-456"],
  "action": "auto_rebucket",
  "confidence": 0.95,
  "rebucket_summary": {"cust-123": {"from_date":"2026-02-14","to_date":"2026-02-15","tokens_moved":12000}}
}
```
sophie: (note: we will send a compact CSV rather than huge JSONs for large batches).
alec: Quick SQL to find suspect batches (7d):
```
SELECT partner_id, batch_id, count(*) AS events, sum(tokens) AS total_tokens, min(received_at) AS first_seen
FROM partner_usage_events
WHERE partner_id = 'helio' AND partner_timezone IS NULL
  AND received_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY partner_id, batch_id
HAVING sum(CASE WHEN (epoch_ms % 86400000) < 600000 OR (epoch_ms % 86400000) > 85800000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0.6 * count(*)
ORDER BY total_tokens DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
mina: I'll cross-ref with ledgers and prepare a customer impact file. Also draft customer-facing paragraph explaining rebucket rules and off-cycle adjustments.
toby: Add alert: if `partner.helio.tz_ambiguous_count` > 50 in 10m, page eng-oncall. Add ledger lease `ledger.acquire_lease('helio-rebucket', ttl=900)` during reconcile.
sophie: Owners: alec implements enrichment + metrics + webhook sender (ETA 36h staging), toby adds lease/alert/runbook (ETA 12h), mina drafts finance & comms and threshold matrix (ETA 24h). I'll coordinate partner QA.
helio-bot: Scheduled job 'helio-rebucket-staging' created: id hr-20260216-01, owner alec, runs staging 2026-02-16T03:00:00Z.
sophie: thanks team 44d we'll validate sample rebuckets after the staging run.
